people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
translations.bsb: Then John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
translations.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
translations.asv: And John bare witness, saying, I have beheld the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven; and it abode upon him.
